summary.zh: 设计 A/B 测试，估算样本量并解读结果
summary.en: Design A/B tests with sample size and result readouts

description.zh: 为产品功能规划 A/B 测试，写清假设、样本量、运行时长和优先级，并给出结果判读标准。适合在决定要不要做实验、实验跑多久，或拿到数据后判断是否显著时使用。
description.en: Plans product A/B tests with clear hypotheses, sample size, run length and priority, then helps read the results. Use it when asking what to test, how long to run, or whether a test actually won.
